title: Influence of Preoperative Contact Lens Wearing Patterns on Corneal Endothelial Cell Density After Implantable Collamer Lens Implantation

indication: Myopia corrected with implantable Collamer lens (ICL) in the ciliary sulcus; eyes without keratoconus, inflammatory/infectious eye disease, cataract, glaucoma, retinal disease or previous ocular surgery; subgroups by preoperative contact lens wear pattern

groups.indication: No contact lens wear before surgery
groups.description: ICL implantation (3.2 mm main incision, single surgeon, standard procedure); eyes without preoperative contact lens wear

groups.indication: Hard contact lens wear before surgery (discontinued 3 weeks before preoperative measurements)
groups.description: ICL implantation (3.2 mm main incision, single surgeon, standard procedure); hard contact lens wearers

groups.indication: Non-daily soft contact lens wear up to 10 h/day before surgery (discontinued 1-2 weeks before preoperative measurements)
groups.description: ICL implantation (3.2 mm main incision, single surgeon, standard procedure); non-daily soft contact lens wearers

groups.indication: Daily soft contact lens wear of at least 10 h/day before surgery (discontinued 1-2 weeks before preoperative measurements)
groups.description: ICL implantation (3.2 mm main incision, single surgeon, standard procedure); daily long-duration soft contact lens wearers

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute CD for every group; the absolute series are used
Baseline values are cited from Table 2 so each series comes from one table

exclusions.what: Tables 3 and 4 (CV and percentage of hexagonal cells)

notes: All four groups are patient-condition subgroups (preoperative contact lens wear pattern) after the same standard ICL procedure: control-role groups with the condition in the group indication.
230 eyes of 116 patients; both eyes of most patients were analysed without inter-eye adjustment; n counts eyes.
Cases with intraoperative or clinically significant postoperative complications were excluded from the cohort (Methods); this applies to all groups and does not define a group.
